title: Blunder/Brilliant
transcript: Fools will resign. Wise players might make a draw, but only a true genius would be able [music] to win from this position. You see, at first glance, it might seem like we can just take this bishop for free. But, as it turns out, this is a blunder because black can actually just deliver a fork with the knight attacking the king and the rook at the same time. And so, after we move the king, we are just going to lose the rook. And with it, we're also going to lose all of our chances to win this game. But, if we try to go after the knight, for example, now black can start giving us checks. The king has to move. The knight is going to be defended. And believe it or not, this is enough to draw the game. So, what else can we do? Well, some of you might notice that there is an opportunity to create a checkmate in one threat. If we can come here with the rook, this is going to be a checkmate. But, actually, the king is just going to move. Now, there is no checkmate anymore because if we give this check, the king is going to come out. And this is still a draw. So, is this position a draw? Well, not exactly. You see, this is why in chess you need to calculate deeper. We saw that after taking the bishop, we are going to lose the rook, right? But, we didn't stop to consider what happens after that. And as it turns out, the way to win this game is indeed to capture that bishop. That was not a blunder after all. Now, of course, the knight is going to give us a fork. And after we move the king, we are going to lose the rook. But, notice this, the knight doesn't have many squares to use to go back into the game. These two are defended by the king. And these two are the only other squares that the knight can use. And we can take those away with pawn to B4. The knight has no safe legal moves. So, the black king will have to watch while we slowly march towards this black knight, getting closer and closer. And eventually, we are just going to pick it up. If black had one more move, he could use the king as a defender, but unfortunately this is just a win for white. If you like this board, then read the caption.
